description: This file defines the interface for a unit testing Key-Value Pair (KVP) framework in C. It includes type declarations, constants, and function prototypes for creating, managing, and parsing KVP instances, as well as retrieving various data types from the key-value data.

methods.name: ut_kvp_createInstance
methods.description: Creates a new KVP instance and returns its handle; returns NULL on failure.

methods.name: ut_kvp_destroyInstance
methods.description: Destroys a KVP instance and releases its resources.

methods.name: ut_kvp_open
methods.description: Opens and parses a KVP file, populating the instance with key-value pairs.

methods.name: ut_kvp_openMemory
methods.description: Parses a serialized KVP payload from caller-owned memory into an instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_close
methods.description: Closes a KVP instance and frees associated resources.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getBoolField
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean value for a specified key from the KVP instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt8Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint8_t value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt16Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint16_t value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt32Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint32_t value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getUInt64Field
methods.description: Retrieves a uint64_t value for a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getStringField
methods.description: Retrieves a string value associated with the key, copying it into caller-provided buffer.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getFloatField
methods.description: Retrieves a float value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDoubleField
methods.description: Retrieves a double value for a specified key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_fieldPresent
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a key in the KVP instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getData
methods.description: Returns a heap-allocated serialized representation of the entire KVP instance.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getListCount
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in a list associated with a key.

methods.name: ut_kvp_getDataBytes
methods.description: Retrieves data bytes for a specified key, returning a pointer that must be freed by the caller.

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_FILE_OPEN_ERROR,   \/**!< Failed to open the file. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_KEY_NOT_FOUND,     \/**!< Key not found in the KVP instance. *\/$/

ctags.name: UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX
ctags.pattern: /^    UT_KVP_STATUS_MAX                \/**!< Out of range marker (not a valid status). *\/$/
